proofStanding: exact initial-state choice fraction; replayed lower bounds for found recovery continuations; UNKNOWN for bounded misses; heuristic_observation for panel generalization

definitions.choiceDensityConstruct: how many meaningful choices a puzzle offers
definitions.initialViableStartFraction: fraction of nonblocked opening tiles that can start at least one legal chain
definitions.recoveryConstruct: ability to remain solvable after a non-solution move
definitions.oneDetourRecoveryWitnessRate: fraction of up to eight lowest-scoring non-reference candidates from a deterministic 64-candidate pool for which bounded search finds and replays a continuation to target

P1.required: range >= 0.20 and exact invariance in all 32 rows

P2.required: at least 12 eligible non-ceiling pairs, >=75% improve by >=0.125, zero decreases

P3.required: at least 48 comparable arms and >=75% within 0.25
